 Storms bring thunder and lightning to Hobart hours after city tops 30 degrees
 Pulse Tasmania 
 Tue October 20, 2026 6:56pm 
 Storm clouds gathered over Hobart as a band of storms crossed southern Tasmania. Image / Pulse 
 A band of storms has moved over Hobart this afternoon, bringing thunder and lightning to southern Tasmania just hours after the city topped 30 degrees.
 Thick storm clouds gathered over the capital as the system crossed the state’s south.
 Advertisement 
 Bureau of Meteorology observations show Hobart reached 30.4 degrees at 2:22pm. 
 By 6:40pm the temperature had fallen to 16.6 degrees, with a dark band of clouds .
 Storm clouds gathered over Hobart as a band of storms crossed southern Tasmania. Image / Pulse 
 The city’s weather station recorded a wind gust of 50km/h at 5:56pm and 2.2mm of rain since 9am.
 At Hobart Airport, the bureau recorded 4.2mm of rain and a gust of 54km/h at 5:41pm.
 Storm clouds gathered over Hobart as a band of storms crossed southern Tasmania. Image / Pulse 
 Elsewhere in the south, Grove in the Huon Valley had 6.4mm of rain since 9am. Bushy Park in the Derwent Valley recorded a gust of 63km/h at 5:30pm.
 Forecasters expect a shower or two in Hobart this evening.
 Advertisement 
 A heatwave warning is in place for Hobart.
 The bureau is forecasting a top of 24 degrees in the city tomorrow, rising to around 29 on Thursday and 30 on Friday, when showers are also possible.
